name: Aryan
story: Aryan used to spend his nights searching for food. Now, thanks to your support, he hasn't missed a meal in months.
impact: Daily meals and school supplies provided.

name: Meera's Family
story: After losing her job, Meera struggled to feed her three children. Our community kitchen became her lifeline.

name: Old City Slums
story: In the heart of the city, hundreds were going hungry. We established a permanent distribution point here.
